verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a Grok project or space feature that groups related chats and files under shared context and instructions. Team workspaces (grok-docs-39, grok-docs-13), conversation sharing (grok-docs-14) and file connectors (grok-docs-11, grok-docs-36) are adjacent features: they cover business-plan separation, sharing and data access, not project-scoped shared context. The axis clearly applies to a chat assistant, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can organize related chats and files into a project or space that shares context and instructions
